next_step: Start 2-week hosted POC with streaming enabled; deliver SLO/latency target doc + pricing estimate
notes:
Summary: Devlens builds a VS Code-first copilot extension focused on ultra-low latency streaming completions and inline suggestions. Primary goal: make completions feel "instantaneous in-editor" (customer quote).

Recent activity:
- 2025-11-12 initial intro (Fireflies ff_20251112_DevLensIntro). AE Arjun + SE Lena + product lead (Maya R.) 
- 2025-11-18 demo of Redwood hosted streaming; devs tested 3ms token streaming vs competitor samples. AE note: latency looked promising but variance needs smoothing.
- 2025-11-25 security sync: Devlens security team wants SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS integration before any dedicated/private talk.
- 2025-11-27 pricing follow-up; engineering wants a per-active-dev rate model for POC (not just per-token) to estimate costs for 500 internal dev seats.

Technical requirements / asks:
- Target tail latency for inline single-token suggestions: <50ms during typical local dev loops.
- Streaming: want server->client push token streaming with minimal chunking (prefer 20-50ms between chunks).
- Model/version pinning: need to pin stable model for GA and be able to rollout new model variants (canary).
- Fallbacks: must auto-fallback to quantized low-cost model when dedicated capacity saturated.
- Rate limits: per-developer, per-workspace buckets + burst handling; ask for deterministic 429 semantics.
- Auth: support API key for hosted POC, SSO/SAML + SCIM for enterprise later.
- Privacy: configurable retention controls and option to disable dev telemetry for air-gapped enterprise installs.

POC scope proposed:
- 2-week hosted POC, 500 active internal seats, streaming completions + telemetry sampling turned on.
- Redwood to provide latency/trace dashboard and A/B route between base model and optimized quantized variant.
- Success criteria: median latency <30ms, <=5% erroneous completions (per their eval set), stable cost within estimate.

Quotes / friction:
- "It must feel instantaneous in-editor — anything >100ms breaks the UX." — Devlens product lead.
- Legal wants retention controls spelled out before Dedicated evaluation.

Next steps / owner actions:
- AE (Arjun) to send POC terms + hosted pricing estimate by 2025-12-01.
- SE (Lena) to draft routing/canary playbook and SLO doc; set up demo environment and sample VS Code extension hook.
- Security: schedule SAML checklist review (see Drive doc).

Open items / blockers:
- Finalize POC billing model (per-active-dev vs per-token baseline).
- Confirm SSO/login flow for internal devs (SAML metadata exchange).
- Clarify SLA expectations for peak IDE bursts (e.g., large completions triggered by refactor).
